correctness.rationale: The Hamiltonian V(x)=dplus*x^4/4 (x>=0), c|x|^3/3+dminus|x|^4/4 (x<0) is coercive with unique minimum, yielding periodic ovals for E>0. Exact side-time scaling gives P(0,dplus) and P(cE^-1/4,dminus). With inverse potential z_alpha(u), derivative of G_alpha=alpha z²+d z³ satisfies ∂_alpha G=alpha z²/[3(alpha+d z)]>0 for alpha>0, making P strictly decreasing. Beta integrals establish endpoint E^(1/12) and limit. Differentiated regularized root integral gives P_prime(0,d)=-sqrt2/(3d); therefore contrast crossing E* grows like Delta^-4 with displayed coefficient. Inspected independent quadrature code and algebra; finite sampled checks do not prove all energies.
